data_fields.name: max_elapsed_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: 1500 ms cap on time credit per snapshot

data_fields.name: packet_limit
data_fields.donor_constant: 300 packets per 3000 ms, then close and blacklist

data_fields.name: chat_limit
data_fields.donor_constant: 20 chat packets per 2000 ms, then kick and blacklist

data_fields.name: action_limit
data_fields.donor_constant: 25 actions per 6 s window (excludes place, break, command); kick above 60 occurrences

best_idea: Bound each client-claimed position by the speed reachable since the last accepted snapshot (capped), move the server copy by that bounded amount, and send a correction only when the claim is far from it.
decision_why: The bound transfers to zone movement, but not the donor's wall-clock credit, its trust-the-client mode, or its chat and packet kicks that blacklist an IP, which do not fit a phone MMO on carrier NAT.
acceptance: A server test sends a snapshot claiming a position 100 tiles from the last accepted one, 2 s after it, with a speed cap of 4 units per tick: the server moves at most 49.5 tiles (1.5 s capped credit x 60 x 4 x 1.1 = 396 units), and sends a correction because its position is then more than 14 tiles from the claim.
